violation_type.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))
violation_type.short_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk
violation_type.typical_finding: An incident report was not on record or provided for review  during the investigation.

finding_variants.text: An incident report was not on record or provided for review  during the investigation.
The operation did not provide the Licensing Incident/Illness report form, or any written injury/illness form to parents of children that were injured in care.
Based on information obtained during the investigation, the licensing incident and illness report was not completed.
There was no incident report created within the adequate timeframe and the parent was not given a written notification on the details of the incident.
Based on the information obtained, the Licensing Incident Report was not shared with parents regarding a child that was left alone in a classroom.

Based on the investigation conducted, it was determined that an incident report was not generated for the incident that may have placed a child at risk.  A two year old stepped out of the playground onto the sidewalk of the parking lot.
